Before connecting anything

Plan for the unhappy path.

  • Map the source of truth

    Identify which system owns each record, what must move and who is allowed to access it.

  • Review external constraints

    Check API access, subscriptions, rate limits and the quality of the existing data.

  • Handle failures deliberately

    Agree on validation, duplicate handling, retries and how a person can investigate a failed run.

  • Test and document the workflow

    Check the agreed paths with suitable test data and document configuration and recovery steps.
